name: lumina
description: Lumina repository workspace and accessible web foundation

scripts.check: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run api:check && pnpm run manifests:check && pnpm run catalog:artifact-check && pnpm run sky-context:artifact-check && pnpm run migrations:check
scripts.catalog:artifact-check: uv run lumina-catalog ingest --slice gaia-dr3-exoplanet-host-photometry-v1 --validate-only && uv run lumina-catalog ingest --slice gaia-dr3-exoplanet-host-astrometry-v1 --validate-only
scripts.catalog:data-check: uv run lumina-catalog data-check --slice gaia-dr3-exoplanet-host-photometry-v1 && uv run lumina-catalog data-check --slice gaia-dr3-exoplanet-host-astrometry-v1
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:root && pnpm --filter @lumina/api-client typecheck && pnpm --filter @lumina/web typecheck
